title: CAIP media operations and secure review
source_media_guarantees: No source image, video, product_images row, media_assets row, content_project_media row, or R2 source object is copied, transformed, published, moved, reordered, made public, or deleted by Build 202.
Technical observation reads catalog metadata and optional bound R2 object headers only; it does not fetch arbitrary URLs or inspect media bodies.
Derivative records are plans until a later verified provider writes an output object and checksum.
Secure review grants store SHA-256 token hashes only, are administrator-bound, expiry/view capped, revocable, audited, same-origin, and no-store.
